I've updated that line to:

Forum Crit members may decline to review material when the basics are not met, or for other reasons (such as not being interested in the draft or having real-life commitments/time constraints).

Please let me know if a different wording should be used! Also, feel free to contact me directly about this page, as I address PMs faster than discussion comments.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: I would support this change. There are definitely times when I have had to decline reviews for reasons other than what is currently mentioned.

Can I suggest a minor clarification to: "Forum Crit members may decline to review material when the basics are not met."

Uh specifically since this is under the "guidelines for contacting us" section, it feels like it'd be appropriate to say explicitly that they can decline to review material for other reasons too (e.g, not having time, not really being drawn into the draft or w/e)

item.content:encoded:
I don't think we have anyone who specifically specializes in works with K-Class scenarios, since not all articles that mention that element are necessarily the same.

If you're having trouble "getting everything to work well together", maybe try reaching out to someone who is good at narrative, backstories, or story mechanics or the like.

Alternatively, use the Tag Search tool to look up the tag pertaining to k-class scenarios, and seek feedback from authors of high-rated works with that tag.
